newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Renaissance Capital gets debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Renaissance Capital gets debt ratings.

text.p: Offshore-registered investment bank Renaissance Capital Group Ltd, active in Russia, received a short-term local currency debt rating of LC-2 and long-Term senior debt rating of B+ from Thomson BankWatch agency, Thomson said on Thursday.
Renaissance Capital is the first Western-style investment bank to serve exclusively the Russian and the Commonwealth of Independent States capital markets, Thomson said in a statement.

After high gains from trading GKO discount Treasury bills, it has built up equity and fixed income trading operations in Russia and Ukraine, together with investment banking, merchant banking and asset management, it said.
